title: DreamCo Occupation Synthesis Pack (built with O*NET® 31.0 data)
summary: Populated sample (version 0.0.2): 44 occupations (2 per SOC major group) with a small derived subset of O*NET® 31.0 data and DreamCo's own synthesis (capability lenses, data-confidence bands, practice seeds, rubrics, analysis), with per-row source references. Built with O*NET® data; not for sale, no price. Internal SKU id DP-ONET-OCC-SYN is not buyer-facing; a buyer-facing id will be decided before any listing.
known_limitations: Sample only: 44 of 1,016 O*NET-SOC occupations (2 per SOC major group, deterministic seed); not weighted by employment.
license_gate_status is fail: the included asset is approved_for_private_use. Rights checks pass; sale-scope checks fail (no dataset evaluation scorecard, no validation evidence, no owner approval).
Dataset QA scorecard (tools/score_data_package_dataset.py) is integrity evidence only; config/dataset_evaluation_scorecard.json has not been run, so scorecard_score stays null.
No benchmark or holdout results; practice seeds and rubrics are template-generated and ungraded.

Single publisher: every value comes from O*NET® 31.0 (one perspective in multi_perspective_policy terms); rating sources (incumbent, occupational expert, analyst) are recorded per row but are not independent publishers.
DreamCo lens groupings and confidence-band rules are DreamCo's judgment and are not validated against outcomes.
Some ranked ratings date from 2015-07; data_confidence flags them per row.
O*NET® content is third-party (USDOL/ETA, CC BY 4.0); recipients keep their CC BY 4.0 rights in O*NET®-derived values, and attribution plus the non-endorsement notice must ship with every derivative.

Name: display name set to "DreamCo Occupation Synthesis Pack (built with O*NET® 31.0 data)" (Irean Jordan, option A, 2026-10-05; reports/DATA_PACKAGE_LICENSE_QA_REVIEW.md 1.4). The SKU id DP-ONET-OCC-SYN is internal only and contains the letters ONET; a buyer-facing id must be decided before any listing.
US occupational taxonomy only (O*NET-SOC 2019); not validated for other labor markets.
